   311	/* Character accessors. */

   313	#define STR(off)                (ctx->text + (off))

   315	/* Character classification.
   316	 * Note we assume ASCII compatibility of code points < 128 here. */
   317	#define ISIN_(ch, ch_min, ch_max)       ((ch_min) <= (unsigned)(ch) && (unsigned)(ch) <= (ch_max))
   318	#define ISANYOF_(ch, palette)           ((ch) != _T('\0')  &&  md_strchr((palette), (ch)) != NULL)
   319	#define ISANYOF2_(ch, ch1, ch2)         ((ch) == (ch1) || (ch) == (ch2))
   320	#define ISANYOF3_(ch, ch1, ch2, ch3)    ((ch) == (ch1) || (ch) == (ch2) || (ch) == (ch3))
   321	#define ISASCII_(ch)                    ((unsigned)(ch) <= 127)
   322	#define ISBLANK_(ch)                    (ISANYOF2_((ch), _T(' '), _T('\t')))
   323	#define ISNEWLINE_(ch)                  (ISANYOF2_((ch), _T('\r'), _T('\n')))
   324	#define ISWHITESPACE_(ch)               (ISBLANK_(ch) || ISANYOF2_((ch), _T('\v'), _T('\f')))
   325	#define ISCNTRL_(ch)                    ((unsigned)(ch) <= 31 || (unsigned)(ch) == 127)
   326	#define ISPUNCT_(ch)                    (ISIN_(ch, 33, 47) || ISIN_(ch, 58, 64) || ISIN_(ch, 91, 96) || ISIN_(ch, 123, 126))
   327	#define ISUPPER_(ch)                    (ISIN_(ch, _T('A'), _T('Z')))
   328	#define ISLOWER_(ch)                    (ISIN_(ch, _T('a'), _T('z')))
   329	#define ISALPHA_(ch)                    (ISUPPER_(ch) || ISLOWER_(ch))
   330	#define ISDIGIT_(ch)                    (ISIN_(ch, _T('0'), _T('9')))
   331	#define ISXDIGIT_(ch)                   (ISDIGIT_(ch) || ISIN_(ch, _T('A'), _T('F')) || ISIN_(ch, _T('a'), _T('f')))
   332	#define ISALNUM_(ch)                    (ISALPHA_(ch) || ISDIGIT_(ch))
   333	
   334	#define ISANYOF(off, palette)           ISANYOF_(CH(off), (palette))
   335	#define ISANYOF2(off, ch1, ch2)         ISANYOF2_(CH(off), (ch1), (ch2))
   336	#define ISANYOF3(off, ch1, ch2, ch3)    ISANYOF3_(CH(off), (ch1), (ch2), (ch3))
